display.name: AI Observability Overview
display.description: LLM cost, tokens, latency, errors and cache efficiency, per-trace cost and token usage, and tool-call RED, built on the AI query builder. Scope by model, provider, environment and service from the variable bar; model and provider apply to LLM and per-trace panels only.

display.name: provider

display.name: environment
